description: Create or retrieve a free persistent baseline for public HTTPS HTML, JSON or plain text. Use before Smart Diff or OpenAPI Contract Diff, or to obtain a reusable watch_id/hash for Check. Required url plus optional CSS/JSON exclusions identify the watch; changing rules creates a different watch. Repeating the same registration returns existing state without fetching or refreshing it. Reuse the actual returned watch_id; never invent an ID. Registration is free ($0), subject to quotas, and requires no x402 payment client; subsequent comparison tools are paid. Check also accepts url directly and can create its watch during the paid call. No JavaScript execution or background monitoring. For OpenAPI comparisons register the JSON contract without any content rules.

inputSchema.description: Register a free baseline using a required URL and optional content rules. The canonical URL plus rules identify the watch; changing rules creates a different watch. Repeating the same registration returns its existing watch_id/hash without fetching or refreshing it. Quotas apply. Reuse the returned watch_id in Check, Smart Diff or OpenAPI Contract Diff.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional array of up to 20 JSON Pointer-style paths to remove before JSON normalization and hashing. Each must start with '/' and be 1-256 characters; supports '*' segments. Default: [] (no exclusions). JSON only. Example: ['/updated_at', '/items/*/request_id'].

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional array of up to 20 CSS selectors (each 1-256 characters) to remove from HTML in addition to built-in noise filtering. Default: no extra exclusions ([]). HTML only; use ignore_json_paths for JSON. Example: ['.timestamp', '.ad'].

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

selector.description: Optional HTML scope: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'main' or 'article .content'. Only matching text is normalized; no match returns 422. Omit to normalize the page after built-in noise removal. Not supported for JSON or plain text.

url.description: Required absolute public HTTPS document URL, at most 4096 characters, e.g. 'https://example.com/docs'. Only port 443; no embedded credentials, private/local targets or authenticated pages. Fresh402's own service URLs, including its discovery /openapi.json, cannot be targets; choose an external public document. HTML, JSON and plain text are supported; JavaScript is not executed. DNS, redirect and size limits also apply.

name: fresh402_register
